message: The Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays. Plan Agra Fort or Fatehpur Sikri that day instead.
Red Fort is closed on Mondays.
Air quality in the Delhi region is often poor in winter. Morning fog can also delay trains and flights.
Rohtang Pass needs an online vehicle permit with a daily cap. Book it a few days ahead. Atal Tunnel and Sissu don't need it.
Rohtang Pass is closed for winter. Solang Valley and Sissu (via Atal Tunnel) are the snow options.
Nubra, Pangong, Tso Moriri and other areas beyond Leh need an online permit and environment fee. Foreign nationals need a Protected Area Permit via a registered agent.

High altitude: rest fully for the first 24–48 hours after arrival. Don't schedule high passes (e.g. Khardung La) or long drives on day 1–2. Travellers with heart or lung conditions should consult a doctor first.
The Manali–Leh and Srinagar–Leh highways are usually closed by snow outside roughly June to October. Fly into Leh instead.
Kunzum Pass (Manali side) is usually closed outside roughly June to October. Reach Spiti via Shimla and Kinnaur instead, and expect snow blocks.
Foreign nationals need an Inner Line Permit for the Kinnaur–Spiti border stretch (Jangi to Sumdo). Get it in Shimla, Reckong Peo or Kaza.
Indian citizens need an Inner Line Permit (ILP) for Arunachal Pradesh. Apply online before the trip; it is checked at Bhalukpong.
Foreign nationals need a Protected Area Permit (PAP) for Arunachal Pradesh, usually arranged through a registered tour operator.
Foreign nationals need a Restricted Area Permit to enter Sikkim. Tsomgo Lake and North Sikkim need additional permits.
Tsomgo Lake, Nathu La and North Sikkim need permits arranged through a registered tour operator. Carry photo ID and passport photos. Nathu La is not open every day.
Monsoon floods the ghats. Boat rides may be suspended and the aarti moves to rooftops.
River rafting is suspended during monsoon (roughly July to mid-September).
Very heavy rain around Cherrapunji. Waterfalls are at their best, but root-bridge treks get slippery and Dawki's river is murky.
Eravikulam National Park closes for Nilgiri tahr calving season, typically February to March.
Inter-island ferries sell out in peak season (Dec–Jan). Book ahead and keep a buffer day before your flight out.
Christmas to New Year is peak season: room rates can double or triple. Book early or go in late November or January.
Jaisalmer Desert Festival usually falls in February. Great atmosphere, but hotels fill up early.
Dev Deepawali (full moon after Diwali) lights up every ghat. Spectacular, but boats and rooms get booked months ahead.
The Nehru Trophy snake boat race is held on Punnamada Lake in August. Book stays early if your dates overlap.
